en: A hand-colored historic postcard showing a long, light-colored barracks-style building with a central pavilion, mansard roof, and dormer windows, set behind a large field of greenery. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Printed red and black German text appears on the lower margin, including the town name "Oschatz" and the name of the barracks "Franz Joseph Kaserne." Publisher information and a note indicating it is a hand-colored artist card are also printed at the bottom.
